properties.name: Apple Charlie's South Huron Orchards
properties.address: 38035 S Huron Rd, New Boston, MI 48164
properties.category: destination orchard and cider mill
properties.admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick, hayrides, food, and products priced separately.
properties.notes: Full traditional fall offer with U-pick apples and pumpkins, cider mill and bakery, animal area, pavilion, hayrides, gift retail, hot food, weekend entertainment, and tours. The business's legacy website is intermittent, so current operating details should be reconfirmed before field use.

properties.name: Blake's Big Apple
properties.category: destination orchard and fall attraction
properties.admission_model: Market access is free; paid Funland and haunted attractions, with U-pick, food, and products priced separately.
properties.notes: Distinct current Blake Farms location with U-pick, a 25-plus-activity Funland, school trips, pumpkins, food, bakery and market, plus major nighttime haunted attractions.

properties.name: Blake's Orchard & Cider Mill
properties.category: destination orchard and cider mill
properties.admission_model: Farm market is free to enter; paid Funland and separately priced U-pick, food, beverages, and events.
properties.notes: Blake Farms' flagship 120-acre destination combines U-pick, pumpkins, extensive family attractions, school trips, bakery and farm market, grill, hard cider, events, and year-round programming.

properties.name: Blake's South Lyon
properties.address: 61475 Silver Lake Rd, South Lyon, MI 48178
properties.category: large orchard, cider mill, farm park and cidery
properties.school_programs: Educational programming, camps and group/fall-party packages available.
properties.admission_model: Farm store access is free; Funland is ticketed. 2026 standard Funland price published as $9.95.
properties.notes: Former Erwin Orchards property. Operated by Blake Farms and now branded Blake's South Lyon; some pages still use 'Blake's Lyon Township.'

properties.name: Erie Orchards & Cider Mill
properties.category: destination orchard and cider mill
properties.admission_model: Free market entry; U-pick, attractions, tours, food, and products priced separately.
properties.notes: Approximately 70 production acres and a reported 100,000-plus annual visitors, with U-pick fruit and pumpkins, bakery and cider press, large store, corn maze, play and animal areas, wagon rides, festivals, food, and tours serving more than 10,000 participants annually.

properties.name: Plymouth Orchards & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and fall agritourism
properties.school_programs: Guided weekday school/group tours with apple education, wagon ride, cider and donut; pumpkin option after October 1.
properties.admission_model: Free admission and parking; selected rides and products priced separately.
properties.notes: Core local benchmark near Plymouth/Northville. Main mill is distinct from its Red Shed Market satellite at 10260 Ann Arbor Rd.

properties.name: Three Cedars Farm
properties.category: pumpkin farm and fall entertainment destination
properties.admission_model: Free general admission and parking; activities individually ticketed.
properties.notes: One of the closest full fall-experience competitors. Official site lists September 4, 2026 opening.

properties.name: Westview Orchards & Winery
properties.category: destination orchard and winery
properties.admission_model: Market and winery access is generally free; paid seasonal farm admission, U-pick, food, and products.
properties.notes: Long-running multi-season agritourism destination with U-pick fruit and pumpkins, cider and bakery, farm market, family play and wagon activities, school tours, winery, food, events, and rentals.

properties.name: Wiard's Orchards & Country Fair
properties.category: large orchard, cider mill and ticketed farm amusement destination
properties.school_programs: School field trips for groups of 20+ include educational activities, picking, wagon ride, cider and donut.
properties.admission_model: Country Store is free; Country Fair and U-pick areas require online ticket admission, with some add-ons.
properties.notes: Major destination competitor with broad activity inventory, school business and nighttime haunted programming.

properties.name: DeBuck's Family Farm
properties.category: large ticketed seasonal farm amusement destination
properties.admission_model: Ticketed, cashless festival operation; 2026 sunflower admission published at $16.95, age 23 months and under free.
properties.notes: Major experiential competitor south/east of the core; official 2026 Fall Festival runs September 12-October 31.

properties.name: Dexter Cider Mill
properties.category: historic cider mill and bakery
properties.admission_model: Free entry; purchases à la carte. Cash or check only, with onsite ATM.
properties.notes: Michigan's oldest continuously operating cider mill; powerful heritage competitor but limited farm activities.

properties.name: Jenny's Farm Market & Cider Mill
properties.category: farm market, cider mill and family farm attraction
properties.school_programs: Group/field-trip package advertised with hayride, pumpkin, donut and cider.
properties.admission_model: General market access appears free; rides and group packages separately priced.
properties.notes: Close Dexter-area competitor. No reliable standalone official website located; reputable local directory used.

properties.name: Long Family Orchard, Farm & Cider Mill
properties.address: 1540 E Commerce Rd, Commerce Township, MI 48382
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and ticketed fun farm
properties.admission_model: Free parking and market access; Fun Farm is ticketed, with selected add-ons.
properties.notes: Strong northwest Oakland County destination; official site lists September 6 opening for cider mill and Fun Farm.

properties.name: Obstbaum Orchards & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and country store
properties.admission_model: No general admission identified; products and selected activities priced separately.
properties.notes: 27-acre orchard in Salem Township; U-pick and hayrides are crop/weather dependent.

properties.name: Parmenter's Northville Cider Mill
properties.category: urban cider mill and bakery
properties.admission_model: Free admission and parking; purchases à la carte.
properties.notes: Highly proximate historic urban mill. Adjacent Northville Winery & Brewing adds hard cider, beer and wine.

properties.name: Porter's Orchard Farm Market & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill, and farm market
properties.admission_model: Free admission; U-pick, corn maze, hayrides, events, and products priced separately.
properties.notes: Third-generation orchard with U-pick apples and pumpkins, cider and donuts, market, play area, petting farm, hayrides, corn maze, rentals, and educational orchard and mill tours.

properties.name: Wasem Fruit Farm
properties.category: working fruit farm, U-pick orchard and cider mill
properties.school_programs: Pre-arranged school tours offered mid-September through October.
properties.admission_model: No general admission identified; pay for picked produce and purchases.
properties.notes: Authentic U-pick competitor south of Ann Arbor. Availability and opening days change with crops.

properties.name: Alber Orchard & Cider Mill / Freedom Winery
properties.category: historic orchard, cider mill and winery
properties.admission_model: General farm access appears purchase-based; winery reservations and selected activities may be separately priced.
properties.notes: Official site says cider mill is closed for the season, not permanently closed; spring/summer 2026 winery visits are reservation-based.

properties.name: Franklin Cider Mill
properties.category: historic cider mill, bakery and market
properties.admission_model: Free entry; purchases à la carte.
properties.notes: High-brand-recognition mill on Detroit-side edge of study area; experience is food/heritage-led rather than farm-activity-led.

properties.name: Goodison Cider Mill
properties.category: cider mill and bakery market
properties.admission_model: Free entry; products priced individually.
properties.notes: Compact seasonal mill known for cider, donuts, pistachio and pumpkin breads, pies, candy, preserves, apples, and caramel apples. Official materials show a retail-led visit without a farm-activity or school-program component.

properties.name: Grainger's Orchard & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and fall farm
properties.admission_model: No general-admission model verified; activities and products may be separately priced.
properties.notes: Meaningful Howell-side competitor; official operational detail was limited, so uncertain fields remain null.

properties.name: Hy's Cider Mill
properties.category: small orchard and cider mill
properties.admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick and store products priced separately.
properties.notes: Weekend-only traditional mill and apple U-pick with cider, donuts, pumpkins, and a modest family-oriented orchard visit. No current structured school program or substantial food service was verified.

properties.name: Parshallville Cider Mill
properties.category: historic cider mill
properties.admission_model: Free entry; mill products priced individually.
properties.notes: Historic seasonal grist mill, also known as Tom Walker's Grist Mill, centered on cider, donuts, baked goods, and a scenic mill visit. It does not present a broad farm-activity or school-tour offer.

properties.name: Rochester Cider Mill
properties.category: cider mill and farm market
properties.admission_model: Free entry; products priced individually.
properties.notes: Seasonal mill with cider, daily donuts, pies and farm-market goods, plus pumpkins, a straw pyramid, and a petting farm. No U-pick or current school-tour program is advertised.

properties.name: Spicer Orchards Farm Market & Winery
properties.category: large orchard, U-pick farm, cider mill and winery
properties.school_programs: Weekday appointment tours include education, wagon ride, picking, cider, donut and play area.
properties.admission_model: $5 wristband for orchard/playground/wagon access; picking containers, maze and special rides extra.
properties.notes: Major north-side destination and school-tour competitor, but near the outer drive-time limit.

properties.name: The Blast Corn Maze at Nixon Farms
properties.category: corn maze and pumpkin attraction
properties.admission_model: Ticketed corn-maze attraction; pumpkins purchased separately.
properties.notes: Close Dexter competitor for fall entertainment and pumpkins, but not verified as a cider/donut destination.

properties.name: Yates Cider Mill
properties.address: 1990 E Avon Rd, Rochester Hills, MI 48307
properties.category: historic water-powered cider mill and bakery
properties.school_programs: Weekday tours available by appointment through October.
properties.admission_model: Free entry; food, tours and selected activities separately priced.
properties.notes: Iconic regional destination but northeast of the core trade area.

properties.name: Bennett's Orchard & Broken Barrel Hard Cider
properties.category: orchard market, cider mill and hard-cider tasting room
properties.admission_model: Free market/tasting-area access; purchases à la carte.
properties.notes: Official site states no U-pick apples for 2026 while replacement trees mature; not a closure.

properties.name: Coleman's Farm Market
properties.category: seasonal produce and fall-decoration market
properties.admission_model: Free retail-market access.
properties.notes: Retail-only fall competitor. Distinct from Coleman's Farm Markets at 910 Ridge Rd.

properties.name: Diehl's Orchard & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and family fall farm
properties.school_programs: Weekday tours for groups of 15+, with basic, hayride and pumpkin packages.
properties.admission_model: Free admission and many free activities; hayrides, pumpkins, pony rides and tours separately priced.
properties.notes: Officially confirms no U-pick apples. 2026 season runs August 15-November 22 on varying schedules.

properties.name: Gust Brother's Pumpkin Farm
properties.category: pumpkin farm and free-admission fall destination
properties.school_programs: Weekday school tours with farm education, hayride and pumpkin; cider/donut option available.
properties.admission_model: Free admission and parking; hayrides, products and food separately priced.
properties.notes: Well-developed free-admission model, but oriented toward Toledo and southern Lenawee/Monroe markets.

properties.name: Kackleberry Farms
properties.address: 6421 N Stoney Creek Rd, Monroe, MI 48162
properties.category: large ticketed fall festival and farm amusement attraction
properties.admission_model: Ticketed and cashless; 2026 weekend admission $21.99 online/$25 gate, weekday specials $16.99, ages 2 and under free.
properties.notes: Strong entertainment-format comparator in Monroe, but outside the primary target drive shed.

properties.name: Kapnick Orchards
properties.category: year-round orchard market, bakery and cider mill
properties.school_programs: School tours offered; tour cider is UV treated.
properties.admission_model: Free market access; picking, tours and events separately priced.
properties.notes: Year-round retail strength and broad product line, but outside the core west/southwest catchment.

properties.name: Kreps Apple Barn & Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and farm market
properties.admission_model: No general admission identified; purchases and picking priced separately.
properties.notes: Strong traditional orchard offer but south of the primary catchment.

properties.name: Lesser Farms & Orchard
properties.category: working orchard and farm store
properties.admission_model: Free farm-store access; purchases à la carte.
properties.notes: Officially states no U-pick, hayrides, corn maze or petting zoo; useful retail-price and local-product competitor.

properties.name: Mueller's Orchard and Cider Mill
properties.category: orchard, cider mill and event farm
properties.admission_model: No general-admission model verified; products and activities separately priced.
properties.notes: Outer Flint/Linden competitor with full traditional cider-mill offer.

properties.name: The Frosty Apple / Frosty Apple Orchard
properties.category: small orchard, bakery and farm stand
properties.admission_model: Free farm-stand access; purchases à la carte.
properties.notes: Approximately five acres and 1,600 trees. Primarily an apple and pie competitor; current sources do not substantiate cider or donuts.

properties.name: Wing Farms
properties.address: 5335 Dexter Ann Arbor Rd, Ann Arbor, MI 48103
properties.category: working farm and pumpkin destination
properties.admission_model: Free admission, parking and weekend hayrides; products purchased separately.
properties.notes: Close adjacent pumpkin competitor rather than a cider-mill competitor. Official 2026 pumpkin dates are September 26-October 26.
